needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk on the right side to provide safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians crossing where visibility and stopping compliance might be poor

needed.suggestion: Introduce a refuge island in the pedestrian crossing to provide a safe waiting area in the middle of wide roads.
